samples.name: prop-rye-sprout
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Supplied Kenney sheets are STYLE references only. Single sprite for cozy medieval Slavic village farming game. Short bright-green grass-like rye shoots in a row. Centered small seedling cluster occupying 7x4 logical pixels, no grain ears. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged to square canvas. Each logical pixel one large flat square. Extremely simple Kenney Tiny Farm style, maximum three flat shades per material, top-left light. Top-down three-quarter south-facing view. Fully transparent background and gaps between stalks. No ground, soil, pot, shadow, scenery, text, gradients, antialiasing, haze, neon fringes or tiny realistic detail. Keep stalks connected and readable at actual 16x16 resolution.
